name: The scepter and the secret
summary: Believing the infiltrator loyal, Drakuru grants a scepter as a token of trust and reveals his design: the Drakkari will be swept aside so he can claim Gundrak. The Scepter of Domination offers access to the upper chamber and to weapons still hidden from view. It is no legacy of a mage or ancient sand empire, but a tool in this betrayal, bound to the blight-born force Drakuru commands. Trust has given the conspirator the means to turn his own weapon back upon him.
